label: 6c-xl-g
tail:
No fatal findings.

1. `cor-monic-resultant-is-unchanged-modulo-f`, `[L2]`, citing `def-polynomial-evaluation-and-root`

- Restatement claims: “Polynomial evaluation is a ring homomorphism and an element \(a\) is a root of \(f\) exactly when \(f(a)=0\).”
- Cited Definition says only:
  > “The value of \(f\) at \(s\) along \(\varphi\) is \(f_\varphi(s):=\sum_i\varphi(a_i)s^i\).”
  >
  > “An element \(s\in S\) is a root or zero of \(f\) when \(f_\varphi(s)=0_S\).”
- The Definition does not state that evaluation is a ring homomorphism.
- Step 1.1 uses the omitted homomorphism properties to evaluate \(g-g_1=qf\). However, the step also cites `algebra`, and additivity and multiplicativity follow immediately by expanding the displayed evaluation formula.
- Severity: `nonfatal` — inaccurate citation, but the needed calculation closes within 30 seconds.

2. `cor-double-orthogonal-complement-and-dimension`, `[L2]`, citing `cor-dimension-of-a-direct-sum`

- Restatement claims: “Dimensions add across an internal direct sum of finite-dimensional subspaces.”
- Cited Statement is explicitly finite-family:
  > “Let \(n\in\mathbb N\) … let \(U\) be a family … indexed by \(i<n\) … Then \(V\) is finite-dimensional and
  > \(\dim_FV=\sum_{i<n}\dim_FU_i\).”
- The restatement omits that the direct-sum family is finite. For an infinite family of nonzero finite-dimensional summands, the resulting space need not be finite-dimensional; under the library’s `def-dimension`, its dimension is then not even defined.
- No numbered step depends on the enlargement: step 1.1 applies the result only to the binary decomposition \(V=W\oplus W^\perp\).
- Severity: `nonfatal` — inaccurate but harmless at the listed use.

Coverage: opened and read the complete Statement/Definition of all 37 published targets; checked all 81 named citation edges and every listed use step. The citing items were sampled at their named Facts and numbered steps rather than read cover-to-cover. All 37 targets’ statement provenance was checked; none is `ai-generated`. Nothing in the assigned surface was inaccessible.
